name: aipg
description: A mod handle on AI Power Grid — the community-powered grid where people run the workers and open-weight models for text, image, video and audio are served behind an OpenAI-shaped API, paid in USD-denominated credits. The legacy AI-Horde-style /api/v2 is retired; everything here speaks the current /v1. Two measured facts shape the module: /v1/models is the TEXT surface only (6 ids against 12 in the roster), so the image, video and audio models are invisible to any plain OpenAI client pointed at the grid; and a configured price is not availability — the price book says so itself. So the roster comes from /v1/status/models, and models() joins it to the price book and the live worker list, case-insensitively because the grid writes 'FLUX.2 Klein 4B FP8' in one place and 'flux.2 klein 4b fp8' in the other. One row then answers both questions a caller has: can I use this, and what will it cost. Reads need no key. Generation and credits need one, and it is written to ~/.mod/aipg/key.json at 0600 — never into this repo. Stdlib only: urllib, no service, no port, because the fn surface is already served at /aipg/api.

wraps.kind: hosted API — nothing is vendored or installed
wraps.auth: API key from console.aipowergrid.io, sent as Authorization: Bearer (apikey: also accepted)

state: ~/.mod/aipg — key.json (0600) and out/ for generated media. Nothing private is written into this repo.

public.GET /v1/status/models: the real roster — name, type (text|image|video|audio), worker count, context, perf
public.GET /v1/models: OpenAI-shaped id list — TEXT ONLY, a subset of the roster
public.GET /v1/pricing: price book, USD, ledger unit micro_usd; rates do not imply availability

env.AIPG_API_KEY: key to use, wins over the stored one
env.AIPG_TIMEOUT: seconds per request (default 180 — video is slow)
